Sounds from Freesound (https://freesound.org), each released under
Creative Commons 0 (public domain, https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/).
Credit is not required; the creators are thanked here.
Downloaded 2026-10-22 as the HQ Ogg previews through the Freesound API, then
loudness-matched, trimmed, mixed to mono (all but amb_*) and crossfaded into seamless loops (amb_*, loop_*).

amb_meadow.ogg       "Mountain Meadow Switzerland Birds Insects distant cowbells.wav" by Tonmeister88 - https://freesound.org/people/Tonmeister88/sounds/454841/
amb_stove.ogg        "Fireplace woodstove with the lid open" by HullMusic - https://freesound.org/people/HullMusic/sounds/718202/
loop_river.ogg       "Small Brook Flowing Around Rocks" by pepasystem - https://freesound.org/people/pepasystem/sounds/819768/
loop_waterfall.ogg   "Ambiance_Waterfall_Small_Close_Loop_Stereo.wav" by Nox_Sound - https://freesound.org/people/Nox_Sound/sounds/698306/
loop_fountain.ogg    "Fountain Babbling" by CheatinSloth - https://freesound.org/people/CheatinSloth/sounds/738777/
sheep_1.ogg          "Ewe baa" by satoristudios3 - https://freesound.org/people/satoristudios3/sounds/677221/
sheep_2.ogg          "Sheep baaing 3 - Norwegian sheep expressing itself concisely" by michaelperfect - https://freesound.org/people/michaelperfect/sounds/710298/
sheep_3.ogg          "Sheep baaing 5 - Norwegian sheep expressing itself concisely" by michaelperfect - https://freesound.org/people/michaelperfect/sounds/710300/
sheep_4.ogg          "Ewe Shetland Sheep Baa" by satoristudios3 - https://freesound.org/people/satoristudios3/sounds/692900/
hen_1.ogg            "Chicken" by D4XX - https://freesound.org/people/D4XX/sounds/607245/
hen_2.ogg            "R01-58-Close Chicken Vocals.wav" by craigsmith - https://freesound.org/people/craigsmith/sounds/479593/
page_1.ogg           "Page Turn - 13" by SpaceJoe - https://freesound.org/people/SpaceJoe/sounds/484933/
page_2.ogg           "Page Turn - 20" by SpaceJoe - https://freesound.org/people/SpaceJoe/sounds/484940/

Animal voices, added 2026-10-22. Freesound itself could not be reached, so
these CC0 originals were taken from open-source games that redistribute them
(trimmed) and name each source and licence in their attribution files; here
they were loudness-matched, trimmed and mixed to mono.
cow_1.ogg            "Moo 3 - Moo Moo the Cow" by manofham - https://freesound.org/s/700380/ (via ParadiseSS13/Paradise sound/creatures/cow.ogg, sound/Attributions.txt)
pig_1.ogg            "Pig Oink" by qubodup - https://freesound.org/s/442906/ (via ParadiseSS13/Paradise sound/creatures/pig.ogg, sound/Attributions.txt)
dog_1.ogg, dog_2.ogg  dog barks by KFerentchak - https://freesound.org/people/KFerentchak/sounds/235912/ (via space-wizards/space-station-14 Resources/Audio/Animals/dog_bark1.ogg, dog_bark3.ogg, attributions.yml)
cat_purr_1.ogg       "cat-purr-twit5.wav" by steffcaffrey - https://freesound.org/s/262310/ (via Tuxemon/Tuxemon mods/tuxemon/sounds/monster/, ATTRIBUTIONS.md)
cat_meow_1.ogg       "cat-meow3.wav" by steffcaffrey (via Tuxemon/Tuxemon mods/tuxemon/sounds/monster/, ATTRIBUTIONS.md: "licensed under CC0")
